tab-items.use: Individual tab; unselected/hover/pressed + selected first/middle/last; selected shows a brand-red indicator.

tab-track.use: Bottom rule under the tabs; elevation variant casts a shadow.

overflow-dropdown.use: Trigger that reveals hidden tabs in a menu.

tokens.selected-indicator: color/primary (#db0011 PRIMITIVE) — see tokenValidation (should be tabs/active)
tokens.focus: focus/ring (mode-aware #305A85 light / #4587A7 dark) @ focus/ring-width 2px, focus/ring-offset 2px — see guidelines/focus-indicators.md. Independent of the brand-red selected indicator.

accessibility.semantics: Use role=tablist / tab / tabpanel with aria-selected and roving tabindex; arrow keys move between tabs
accessibility.selected: Selected tab must not rely on the red indicator colour alone — expose aria-selected (1.4.1)
accessibility.overflow: Overflow dropdown must be keyboard-operable and announce hidden tabs
accessibility.focus: Each tab and the overflow trigger show a 2px focus/ring outline (2px offset) on :focus-visible — see guidelines/focus-indicators.md. The ring is distinct from the brand-red selected indicator (focused≠selected). In the overflow menu the focused item must scroll into view with its ring unclipped (2.4.11).

antiPatterns: Indicating the active tab by the red underline colour alone (add aria-selected)
Using tabs for sequential steps (use a progress tracker / wizard)
Binding the selected indicator to the color/primary primitive instead of the mode-aware tabs/active token (loses dark mode — see tokenValidation)
Changing the tab label's font-weight on selection (changes width and makes tabs jump) — show selection via the indicator + colour, keep weight constant

Removing the focus outline (outline:none) or relying on the selected indicator as the focus ring — focus must be a distinct 2px focus/ring on :focus-visible (2.4.7); see guidelines/focus-indicators.md

dimensions.$description: Geometry the generator would otherwise invent. Asserted values adopted from the Route A fitness build (2026-06-19); items tagged review still need design confirmation.

tab-height.$note: tab item height; comfortably exceeds the 44px min target (2.5.8).

min-target.$note: WCAG 2.5.8 minimum; the 48px height satisfies it.

width.$note: s313-D42 (Dave, 2026-10-01): the Tabs part FILLS ITS CONTAINER by default (was a 640px demo setting, moved to a real default under s258-D3). The panel's text keeps its 52ch reading width; the strip collapses tabs into More when they do not fit.

selected-indicator.behaviour: The selected indicator slides horizontally to the active tab (animating left + width), rather than cutting instantly.
selected-indicator.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, disable the slide (indicator moves instantly); retain only the colour transition.
selected-indicator.$confidence: asserted — adopted from Route A fitness test 2026-06-19; tokens in tokens/motion.json

panel.behaviour: Panel content fades/translates in on tab change.

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: WIRING ISSUE — values resolve, but the component is NOT using its dedicated tabs/* semantic group. A mode-aware tabs/* group exists in the variables yet the component binds primitives + tertiary/* + a deprecated token, so it will NOT pick up dark-mode values.

tabsGroupMismatch.note: A full mode-aware tabs/* token group exists but is unused by this component:
tabsGroupMismatch.impact: Tabs render correctly in light mode but lose the dark-mode swaps the tabs/* tokens carry.

depricateUsage.note: Beyond the 2 deprecated tokens, the bigger fix is rewiring to the tabs/* group (above). Tab track + overflow menu items are otherwise clean.
